digest.component_or_area: Anthropic provider test doubles and lazy import isolation
propositions: Three Anthropic auth held-out tests fail with TypeError when a function-shaped monkeypatch of anthropic.AsyncAnthropic is applied before pydantic_ai.providers.anthropic is first imported, due to runtime union evaluation capturing the function instead of a class.

The root cause is test-double representation, not production validation logic; replacing function-shaped patches with class-shaped doubles preserves the fail-if-constructed tripwires and restores the intended secret-free LLMConfigError contract.

A fresh-process oracle starting with the provider absent from sys.modules confirms the import-order defect and validates that class-shaped test doubles allow proper auth validation to execute before client construction.
The defect is isolated to test_rp04_s4_llm_runtime_heldout.py monkeypatch sites; all sibling SDK/provider patches either pre-import the provider or already use class-shaped doubles.

Repairing the three AsyncAnthropic function patches to classes fixes the conflict-error tests while maintaining all existing fail-fast auth assertions and achieving full suite pass with no production source changes.
